d:
That restless itch to check your phone? The struggle to finish a book? It's not just you. Our brains are experiencing the biggest rewiring in human history - and it's happening in real-time.
In this deep dive, discover how our ancient neural circuitry collides with the modern attention economy. From the science of dopamine to the evolution of human thought, we'll explore what's at stake when we can't think deeply anymore - and what we can do about it.
